summary: A hot inflation report hit tech hard, with the Nasdaq down over 2 percent and the VIX spiking nearly 12 percent as rate-hike fears returned. Chip stocks bore the brunt of the selloff.
market_note: Indexes deep in the red midday; volatility surging as hot CPI data resets rate expectations.

items.why: Down nearly 6 percent in the AI-chip selloff after hot inflation data revived rate-hike fears. Investors shrugged at its Helion rack blueprint, and the rich valuation is punishing the stock.
Sliding with chip stocks as hot CPI data dents high-multiple growth names. Last week's report of a lower-than-expected OpenAI revenue run rate is still weighing on the AI trade.
